resources.string: Enables simulated touch gestures and automated clicking to assist users with motor limitations and repetitive tapping tasks.

Required for automated click and gesture simulation

Auto Clicker requires Android\'s AccessibilityServices API solely to perform automated touch gestures (taps and clicks) on your screen on your behalf. This is the core functionality that enables automatic clicking.
The app uses Android\'s dispatchGesture() API to dispatch touch inputs at the precise screen coordinates and time intervals you configure across Single, Multi, and Grid click modes.
No personal or sensitive user data is collected, stored, or shared.
No screen content, window hierarchies, or messages are read or monitored.
No keystrokes, passwords, or payment credentials are recorded.
The app is 100% offline and requests zero internet permissions.
